description: Indigo-Open-Data-IRVE is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Indigo Group. As part of the establishment of a national register of charging stations for electric vehicles, freely accessible to the public, local authorities and operators deploying new stations must publish, as soon as they are put into service, the corresponding technical and geographical information on the data.gouv.fr platform, in accordance with the order of 4 May ... Coverage: Indigo Group. The publisher named on the listing is Indigo Group. Its keywords include irve, bornes-de-recharge-electrique, station-de-charge, bornes-de-recharge, borne-de-recharge-vehicule-electrique, charging-station. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2026-08-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
